title: Rare-Event Quantum Sensing Using Logical Qubits
summary: Integrating quantum error correction into a sensing protocol improves detection of rare events in noisy environment.

title: Millimeter Wave Readout of a Superconducting Qubit
summary: A new device uses millimeter-wave radiation to accurately read the states of superconducting qubits without altering them.

title: Designing a Low-Loss High-Reflectivity Mirror for Gravitational-Wave Detectors by Combining a Dielectric Metasurface and a Multilayer Stack
summary: The design of low-mechanical-loss, high reflectivity mirrors is crucial in the development of the next generation of gravitational-wave observatories. title: Particle-Soliton Degeneracy in 2D Quantum Chromodynamics
summary: Exact results in mass-gapped two-dimensional QCD show that spontaneously broken noninvertible symmetry often places particles and solitons in one multiplet, forcing equal masses.

title: Parton Distribution Functions from Large-Momentum Expansion of Current-Current Correlators
summary: The universality of the large-momentum effective theory (LaMET) allows computing parton distribution functions starting from any Euclidean correlator with appropriate large-momentum Fourier components. summary: Located at the neutron shell closure $N=8$, the long-lived radioactive isotope $^{14}\mathrm{C}$ plays a critical role in geochronology and nuclear structure studies. summary: Fe dopants on the surface of a ${\mathrm{Bi}}_{2}{\mathrm{Te}}_{3}$ thin film grown on a superconducting ${\mathrm{NbSe}}_{2}$ substrate by molecular beam epitaxy are investigated by a dilution-refrigerator scanning tunneling microscope. Utilizing the tip-induced band bending effect, we precisely ma…

title: Experimental Observation of Erratic Non-Hermitian Skin Effect in Phononic Crystals
summary: The erratic non-Hermitian skin effect (ENHSE), emerging from the interplay between disorder and locally nonreciprocal yet globally reciprocal couplings, has reshaped the conventional bulk-boundary correspondence through its disorder-dependent localization properties. title: Nonrelativistic Optically Induced Spin Torque in Noncollinear Magnets
summary: Spin torque can be induced in noncollinear magnets by nonlinear light in the absence of nonrelativistic spin-orbit coupling, and can generate an effective magnetic field of ~30 Tesla under modest light in realistic materials.

title: Plasmascopy of Ultrafast Hot Charge Carriers
summary: We demonstrate an electric-field-resolved approach for probing ultrafast dynamics of photoinjected charge carriers in solids. title: Reduced Gravitational Wave Signal Reopens the Ultralight Primordial Black Hole Window
summary: The hot big bang may have emerged from evaporation of primordial black holes (PBHs) lighter than ${10}^{9}\text{ }\text{ }\mathrm{g}$. title: Quantum Monte Carlo Studies of U(1) Lattice Gauge Models of Kondo Breakdown
summary: In the local-moment regime, heavy fermions are most economically described by a compact U(1) gauge theory. title: Consistent Time Reversal and Reliable and Accurate Inference in the Presence of Memory
summary: Thermodynamic inference from coarse observations remains a key challenge. Memory, in particular correlations between consecutively observed mesostates, blur signatures of irreversibility and must be accounted for in defining physical time reversal, which remains an open problem. title: Curvature Potential Formulation for Thin Elastic Sheets
summary: Thin sheets, from graphene to biological membranes, exhibit wrinkling, folding, and thermal deformations driven by geometric nonlinearities. They are treated using weakly nonlinear theories such as the Föppl–von Kármán equations, whose reliance on small slopes and a single-valued height field exclud…

title: Emergent Gauge Flux in Mixed ${\mathrm{QED}}_{3}$ with Flavor Chemical Potential: Implications for Magnetized U(1) Dirac Spin Liquids
summary: Quantum Monte Carlo simulations reveal that a Zeeman field drives Dirac spin liquids into a chiral flux phase, forming relativistic spinon Landau levels and gapless photon excitations of the emergent gauge field theory.

title: Tensor-Network Framework for Lindbladian Spectra and Steady States
summary: Researchers develop a tensor-network framework using complex-time evolution to accurately compute low-lying excitation spectra of open quantum systems.

title: Generalized Bogoliubov-Born-Green-Kirkwood-Yvon Hierarchy for Near-Integrable Dynamics
summary: The BBGKY hierarchy is generalized to systems with strong integrable contact interactions and generic long-range two-body ones, enabling the computation of experimentally measurable expectation values and correlations for classical and quantum systems.

title: Information Thermodynamics of Agents: The Work Capacity of Channels with Memory
summary: An information-theoretic model of agents, i.e., complex self-organizing systems, shows that agents must forget parts of their past actions in order to operate at thermodynamic efficiency.

title: Moving Heterointerface with Robustly High Thermal Conductance
summary: Structural superlubricity between gold micromesas and graphite enables high, wear-free interfacial thermal conductance that remains insensitive to sliding and rotation.

title: Production and Decay Dynamics of the Charmed Baryon ${\mathrm{Λ}}_{c}^{+}$ in ${e}^{+}{e}^{−}$ Annihilations near Threshold
summary: Researchers observe the transverse polarization of the charmed baryon in electron-positron annihilations using the BESIII detector.

title: Bulklike Costless Domain Walls Driven by Phonon Pair Condensation in ${\mathrm{HfO}}_{2}$
summary: A previously unrecognized governing principle helps to explain the stable electrical properties in some ferroelectric materials like hafnium oxide.

title: Eigenstate Thermalization in Thermal First-Order Phase Transitions
summary: Researchers demonstrate that thermal first-order phase transitions require a generalization of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, leading to the coexistence of distinct eigenstate classes and Schrödinger-cat-like states.
